literal: The letter A having as first letters all; primordial God having as first indeed the world.
translation: All letters have the letter A as their beginning. The world has the primordial God as its beginning.
modern: எழுத்துக்கள் எல்லாம் அகரத்தை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டுள்ளன. அதுபோல, இந்த உலகம் ஆதி பகவனை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.
explanation: This couplet establishes the foundational nature of the divine by comparing it to language. Just as the vowel 'A' (அகரம்) is the first sound and the basis for all other letters in the Tamil alphabet, the primordial God (ஆதி பகவன்) is the origin and sustaining principle of the entire world. The word 'முதல்' (first or beginning) is used twice to emphasize this structural parallel between the alphabet and the universe.
